newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Northern Telecom ratings.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Northern Telecom ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service Ltd said on Thursday that it had confirmed a rating of A (high) on Northern Telecom's long-term debt and a rating of R-1 (low) on the company's commercial paper.
DBRS also said it had confirmed a stable trend on both ratings, citing a surge in Nortel's revenue and earnings during the last two years.

"The gains have been made in each of the main markets and across each of the four main product lines based on the increase in new demand for communication products. This heightened level of demand is expected to continue for some time," DBRS said.
DBRS, however, warned Nortel must contend with strong international competitors on a global scale.
"Nortel will need to continue to expend large amounts to diversify with new products into new international markets," DBRS said.
